<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template whose forward reaction breaks a ketone and a C‑C triple bond, forms a new C‑C bond, and breaks a C‑O bond (typical of a cycloaddition that eliminates a carbonyl and an alkyne). This should give a single-step route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C-O"]
}</action_input>
